Data, execution and interpretation limits
  • 99,744 continuous 15-minute trade and mark candles per asset, January 1, 2024 through November 4, 2026. Binance USD-M prices/marks proxy Hyperliquid execution; observed Hyperliquid funding uses mark-open as an oracle-price proxy. USDT and USDC are treated at dollar parity.
  • Available archive ZIPs were checked against published SHA-256 files. Three missing day-series per asset were repaired from official Binance REST, recorded with response hashes rather than published checksum verification.
  • One old missing funding hour (August 15, 2024 at 13:00 UTC) uses an explicit adverse fallback if a position is open. No new funding gaps. Stress charges adverse 0.01% per hour in either direction.
  • Signals use completed candles and enter at the next open. Known open exits precede later intrabar extremes. Unknown intrabar order resolves conservatively: liquidation before stop, stop before target.
  • Liquidation loses remaining isolated collateral in this conservative proxy; actual book liquidation may retain some margin. Current mainnet precision and maintenance tiers are held fixed. Drawdown is close-marked, not tick-by-tick.
  • Planned risk is 5% of equity, collateral allocation at most 75%, notional at most $150, opening order at least $10, at most two entries per UTC day. The model can lose more than planned. Deposit, withdrawal, bridge, network, depeg and tax costs are excluded.
  • The seven existing and three new hypotheses, assets and leverage comparisons create selection bias. These are simulations, not live returns, adoption or future-profit proof. Wallet signing and testnet trading limits are separate.
